minotaur-kind-keys.description: Refine this same burly dungeon-attendant minotaur. Soften angry eyebrows into relaxed kindly eyes and a gentle closed-mouth smile. Add a clearly readable ring of three chunky old brass keys hanging from his belt beside the apron. Keep his broad imposing size, horns, brown fur, ochre apron, fists, stance and right-facing pose unchanged. Crisp native pixel art, dark outlines, existing restrained palette, broad connected shading, no extra texture. Transparent background.

kobold-a.description: Refine this same whimsical red kobold: give him an asymmetric short deep-teal adventurer coat with one broad turned-up cream collar, a sturdy crossbody leather pouch and a few large brass fasteners. Strong clear costume shapes, not tiny decoration. Preserve face, cream eye wrap, hand cupped to ear, listening pose, red tail, body size and ONE small lowered revolver. No hat, cowboy, extra weapon or armor. Keep native pixel art, dark outlines, simple 2-tone material shading. Transparent.

kobold-b.description: Enrich this same scrappy red kobold with a short asymmetric teal shoulder capelet, one oversized brass clasp and a compact leather belt satchel. Give the clothing a playful crooked silhouette with broad simple folds. Preserve cream eye wrap, reptile face and tail, hand cupped to ear, listening pose, body proportions and ONE small lowered revolver. No hat, cowboy, extra weapon or new colors. Native crisp pixel art, dark outlines, broad quiet shading, not busy marks. Transparent background.
